name: Apoorva Sharma
summary:
▶ Strategic HR Business Partner with 15+ years of experience driving people strategy and
organizational effectiveness across EPC, infrastructure, and energy sectors.
▶ Trusted advisor to CXOs and senior leadership, aligning workforce planning, succession
management, and performance strategy with long-term business growth objectives.
▶ Expertise in talent architecture, leading end-to-end hiring up to Vice President level and
strengthening leadership pipelines through data-led recruitment models.
▶ Builder of high-performance cultures, designing learning & development frameworks,
succession plans, and engagement initiatives to improve productivity and retention.
▶ Operationally strong HR leader with ownership of HR governance, including PMS, payroll,
compliance, budgeting, policy formulation, and HR digitization.
▶ Analytics-driven HR professional leveraging dashboards and workforce insights to enable
informed decision-making and process improvement.
▶ Proven change enabler, delivering structured onboarding and leadership communication
platforms to enhance employee experience and alignment.

responsibilities: ▶ Talent Acquisition & Pipeline Excellence: Built proactive talent pipelines using market intelligence, executive networking, campus programs, and data-driven recruitment models, improving diversity, cost efficiency, and time-to-hire. ▶ Strategic Workforce & Talent Partnering: Drove workforce planning, HR budgeting, senior leadership hiring (up to VP level), and succession planning to align talent strategy with business growth, scalability, and leadership continuity. ▶ Performance, Capability & Leadership Development: Led enterprise PMS, conducted organization-wide TNA, and designed integrated L&D frameworks to strengthen leadership bench strength, capability building, and employee engagement. ▶ HR Operations, Governance & Analytics: Institutionalized recruitment dashboards, governed payroll and statutory compliance, and embedded analytics-driven decision- making to enhance workforce effectiveness and business outcomes.

▶ Strategic Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning: Led end-to-end talent acquisition aligned with workforce plans and evolving business priorities. ▶ Policy Development & HR Analytics: Formulated and institutionalized HR policies, dashboards, organizational structures & manpower analytics.
